qualifier: eIF2alpha kinases (HRI, GCN2), ATF4 and mitochondrial stress
name: eIF2alpha kinase integrated stress response and translational control
rationale: Members concern stress-induced eIF2alpha kinase (HRI, GCN2) signalling, ATF4 induction, translational repression and mitochondrial stress, unlike confusables centred on IRE1/ATF6/XBP1 branches of the ER unfolded protein response.

name: Osteoclast differentiation, fusion and bone resorption
rationale: All members cover osteoclast/macrophage fusion, differentiation (DAP12), proliferation and bone resorption/remodelling, whereas confusables concern M-CSF signalling, IGF responses or osteoblasts.

name: Phospholipase C and inositol trisphosphate calcium signalling
rationale: Members share PLC-coupled receptor signalling (GPCR, lysophospholipid receptors, VEGFR2) generating IP3 and calcium from phosphoinositides, distinct from confusables on cAMP, prostanoid/leukotriene, purinergic or PKC signalling.

name: Nucleoside and nucleobase transport, including nucleoside-analogue drugs
rationale: All members concern transmembrane transport of nucleosides and purine/pyrimidine bases (including SLC29A3 defect and ribavirin/abacavir uptake), whereas confusables concern nucleotide catabolism, thiopurine metabolism or mitochondrial apoptosis.

qualifier: CHD/NuRD nucleosome remodellers and arginine/lysine methylation
name: Nucleosome organisation and CHD/NuRD chromatin remodelling in transcription
rationale: Members cover nucleosome assembly/disassembly, CHD and NuRD remodellers and methylation-linked transcriptional control, distinguishing them from BAF-complex, acetylation and DNA-repair/ADP-ribosylation confusables.

name: RNA polymerase II initiation and promoter escape, including HIV
rationale: All members cover Pol II pre-initiation, initiation, promoter opening and escape (cellular and HIV), while confusables cover elongation, pausing and Tat-dependent HIV elongation.

name: Regulation of leukocyte-endothelial adhesion and extravasation
rationale: Members regulate leukocyte adhesion to vascular endothelium, adhesion molecule production and extravasation, unlike confusables on inflammatory cytokines, endothelial activation or integrin-mediated adhesion.

qualifier: Rab/ARF GTPase regulation at the Golgi
name: Rab/ARF-regulated vesicle tethering and targeting to Golgi
rationale: Members concern vesicle tethering/targeting to and within the Golgi, constitutive secretion and Rab/ARF GTPase regulation, distinct from confusables on Golgi organisation or COPI/COPII coat-mediated transport.

qualifier: autophagosome, phagosome and endosome fusion with lysosomes
name: Vesicle fusion and cargo delivery to lysosomes
rationale: Members concern fusion of autophagosomes, phagosomes, multivesicular bodies and endosomes with lysosomes and Golgi/endosome-to-lysosome transport, while confusables focus on autophagosome assembly and maturation.

core: Lymphocyte homing and lymphoid tissue development
qualifier: B cells and S1P receptor signalling
name: B-lymphocyte homing and secondary lymphoid tissue development
rationale: Members cover lymphocyte migration into lymphoid organs, lymph node/MALT/GALT development, B cell chemotaxis, marginal zone B cells and S1P receptor signalling, whereas confusables emphasise T cell, dendritic cell and CXCR4 chemotaxis.

qualifier: B and T cell antigen receptor signalling and costimulation
name: B and T lymphocyte antigen receptor signalling, activation and development
rationale: Members span BCR/TCR signalling, costimulation/coinhibition, thymic selection, B and T cell differentiation and B/T cell signatures, unlike confusables on early B lineage commitment, myeloid identity or NK cells.

name: IL-12-driven Th1 response and IFN-gamma production
rationale: Members concern IL-12 production and JAK-STAT signalling, Th1 cytokine and IFN-gamma production, while confusables centre on Th1 differentiation, dendritic cell cytokines and MHC expression.

qualifier: RAS GAP negative regulation and oncogenic pathway mutants
name: RAS GAP regulation and oncogenic RAS-MAPK pathway mutants
rationale: Members concern GAP-mediated RAS inactivation, NF1/RAS-GAP/RAS/MAP2K mutants and RSK activation, unlike confusables on ERK inactivation, SOS/SHC activation or RIT/RIN signalling.

name: Protein acetylation and tubulin polyglutamylation
rationale: Members cover histone/lysine/N-terminal acetylation and tubulin glutamylation/deacetylation, distinct from confusables on protein methylation, tubulin folding or histone methyltransferase complexes.

qualifier: p53 and mTORC1 control of glycolysis and pentose phosphate shunt
name: p53 and mTORC1 regulation of glycolytic and pentose-phosphate metabolism
rationale: Members link p53 and mTORC1 signalling with regulation of glycolysis, the pentose phosphate shunt and nucleotide catabolism, unlike confusables driven by FOXO, HIF, NRF2 or fructose 2,6-bisphosphate.

name: VEGF- and Tie2-driven angiogenesis and endothelial differentiation
rationale: Members concern endothelial proliferation, migration, differentiation and sprouting angiogenesis via VEGF/VEGFR and Tie2, whereas confusables concern smooth muscle, shear stress, BMP or cardiac/pulmonary artery morphogenesis.

core: Negative regulation of inflammatory cytokine signalling
name: Suppression of NF-kappaB and TNF/IL-1beta/IL-6 inflammatory cytokines
rationale: All members negatively regulate NF-kappaB signalling or TNF, IL-1beta and IL-6 production, while confusables add TLR/LPS signalling or IL-10/IL-12 and T cell regulation.

name: Plasma membrane phospholipid flipping and scrambling
rationale: Members concern aminophospholipid flippase and calcium-activated scramblase (ANO6) activity with associated membrane repair, blebbing and volume control, distinct from confusables on inter-organelle lipid transfer, apoptotic cell clearance or mechanosensing.

name: FGFR-activated PI3K and phospholipase C-gamma cascades
rationale: Members are the PI3K and PLC-gamma cascades downstream of FGFR1-4 and phosphatidylinositol signalling, whereas confusables cover FRS- and SHC-mediated FGFR branches and ligand binding.

core: Regulation of NK and T cell activation
name: Inhibitory-receptor regulation of NK and T cell activation and tolerance
rationale: Members concern KIR/NK receptor signatures, inhibitory Fc and lymphoid-non-lymphoid interactions, costimulation and peripheral tolerance, distinct from confusables on positive NK/T cytotoxicity or regulatory T cell suppression.

name: Hedgehog signalling through Smoothened, GLI and cilium
rationale: All members concern Hedgehog ligand-receptor interaction, SMO activation, ciliary localisation and GLI transcription, unlike confusables on axial patterning, neural plate and planar cell polarity.

qualifier: miRNA/siRNA and AU-rich element binding proteins
name: MicroRNA silencing and ARE-binding protein mRNA decay
rationale: Members cover small RNA biogenesis and RISC silencing plus ARE-protein, decapping and deadenylation-linked mRNA decay, while confusables emphasise mRNA stabilisation, 3'-end processing or splicing.

qualifier: loss-of-function variants and neuronal gene targets
name: MECP2 regulation, loss-of-function variants and neuronal gene targets
rationale: All members concern MECP2 expression, activity, Rett-type binding/phosphorylation defects and its neuronal transcriptional targets, distinct from confusables on CREB/cAMP signalling, behaviour or HDAC/NCoR repression.

name: Apoptotic nuclear dismantling and DNA fragmentation
rationale: Members concern execution-phase DNA fragmentation, chromatin condensation and nuclear lamina breakdown, unlike confusables on mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilisation and apoptosome activation.

qualifier: germinal centre and T follicular helper costimulation
name: B cell activation, proliferation and germinal centre T-cell help
rationale: Members concern B cell proliferation, survival, differentiation and germinal centre formation with Tfh/ICOS/CD27 help, whereas confusables are B/plasma cell surface signatures and plasma cell differentiation.
